name: Grade 6 T2 Practice: July Week 8 - Conditions and Flowcharts
description: Practice words for simple conditions and robot responses.

words.definition: A word used to start a condition.
words.example: If the sensor sees an obstacle, the robot stops.

words.definition: A rule that must be true for something to happen.
words.example: The condition checks for an object.

words.definition: What happens after an input or condition.

words.example: The condition is true when the object is close.
The condition is false when the path is clear.

words.definition: A diagram that shows steps or choices.
words.example: The flowchart showed what the robot should do.
